anatomy: FROSTBITE is the original Metal Gear Survive boss shown in the actual close game screenshot. An enormous nonhuman cephalopod-like creature: central tilted pointed dark-violet graphite carapace, like a tall rounded asymmetric teardrop/pyramidal dome with three visible large circular shuttered recessed iris plates on its front, fine concentric organic metal ridges and curved overlapping armour. Exactly EIGHT very long thin flexible ribbed grey-white tentacles rooted around the base of this one carapace; long narrow ribbons with sharp black edge ridges, three small pointed red translucent crystal tips and five turquoise icy-blue tips. Tips remain attached to their own tentacles. No human/animal face or ordinary eyes, no teeth or jaws, no extra head stalk, no clothes or machinery rifle. Retain dark purple dome and pale ribbed ribbons from supplied photograph; unseen backside and tentacle occlusions are interpreted conservatively, not claimed exact.
